text:
nina: Quick sync: support asks for clear preview vs apply semantics + telemetry.

marta: Console preview shows diff + simulation but no stable id today. Need auditable id.

dyson: Preview must not pollute SLOs. It should be read-only. We can emit audit logs + low-sample telemetry.

laura: API: POST /v1/configs/preview -> {preview_id, diff, simulation, warnings}. preview_id surfaces in logs.

ankur: Sampling: default 1% for previews. If sensitive keys touched (auth/quotas/kms) escalate to 100%. Mark keys in schema.

marta: Good. Console should show "PREVIEW (not applied)" with preview_id and a "Promote to canary" button that preserves cohort.

dyson: Add preflight mode: X-Config-Mode: preflight runs the simulator synchronously (5s). If constraints fail, return 409 + details. No production metric side-effects.

laura: Preflight should also run a capacity guard: compare expected qps against pool capacity*headroom, return remediation steps if failing.

ankur: Telemetry: emit config.preview.request (sampled), config.preview.sensitive (full), config.preflight.result (pass/fail), config.apply.attempt. Include preview_id/preflight_id tags.

marta: Dashboard: pending changes timeline with previews, preflights, applies. Link events by id.

nina: Action items: laura - API shape + header docs; dyson/ankur - audit + sampling + capacity guard; marta - console badge + promote flow + RFC doc.

ops-bot: Reminder: next config deploy window Tue 02:00 UTC. Preflights must finish before window to be included.
